title: Critical Education and Social Justice
author: HSSA Research Desk
summary: A research brief on how humanities education can sharpen public awareness of inequality, citizenship, and ethical action.
abstract: This project studies the relationship between critical pedagogy, language learning, and civic awareness in South Asian education contexts. It explores how learners connect classroom practice with social justice and public responsibility.

title: Language Access in Higher Education
author: Language Studies Group
summary: A study plan focused on English for disciplinary learning across history, geography, law, economics, and social sciences.
abstract: The study examines how disciplinary English support can reduce barriers for students entering humanities, social sciences, law, medicine, engineering, and natural sciences programs.

title: Reading Clubs and Public Reason
author: Reading Club Collective
summary: A collaborative inquiry into reading communities, dialogue, and critical public thought.
abstract: This project looks at how guided reading groups can build habits of interpretation, listening, disagreement, and civic reasoning beyond formal classrooms.

title: Digital Humanities Platforms
author: Digital Learning Unit
summary: An implementation study for scalable publication repositories, learning portals, and public academic resources.
abstract: The research maps a roadmap for a public-facing digital humanities platform that combines courses, publications, events, workshops, CMS workflows, analytics, and future cloud deployment.
